inlines.v: SCORN'ER, noun 1. One that scorns; a contemner; a despiser. They are great scorners of death. 2. A scoffer; a derider; in Scripture, one who scoffs at religion, its ordinances and teachers, and who makes a mock of sin and the judgments and threatenings of God against sinners. Proverbs 1:22, Proverbs 19:25
